documents.body: Customer Prepayments of $290 Million Have Been Received
documents.extraction_method: manual exact bounded excerpt from retrieved primary source; not full-document snapshot
documents.factual_reading: Signed $1.3bn SiPho contracts for CY2027, $290m received customer prepayments. Larger contractual wafer-volume commitments for 2028; further prepayments due January2027. Dollars are not wafer counts. Customer forecasts beyond contractual minimums are not firm demand. US/CPO allocation UNKNOWN.

documents.body: Over 70% of the total SiPho capacity is either presently reserved or in the process of being reserved through 2028
documents.extraction_method: manual exact bounded excerpt from retrieved primary source; not full-document snapshot
documents.factual_reading: SiPho+SiGe capex $920m total, not additional to its stated components. Installation/full qualification target Q426, full starts2027; >5x Q425 annualized wafer-shipment rate target, absolute baseline UNKNOWN. Reservation statistic combines executed and in-process arrangements. Neither 30% free nor >70% firmly booked can be inferred.

documents.body: with full production readiness expected during the fourth quarter of 2027.
documents.extraction_method: manual exact bounded excerpt from retrieved primary source; not full-document snapshot

Later phase accretive2029 is financial guidance, not exact first qualified-output date. Approximately $3bn net investment after $1bn grants is not physical capacity.
